title: Getting Enough Sleep During Busy Weeks
paragraphs: During a demanding work project, Wafiq stayed up late to finish tasks. He told himself that the habit would end after the deadline.
After three weeks, he found it harder to focus in the daytime. Simple tasks took longer because he was tired.
A doctor friend encouraged him to protect his sleep routine. Wafiq noticed that tired work often led him to make mistakes that took extra time to fix.
He changed his schedule and aimed for seven hours of sleep. Within a week, his work felt clearer and more manageable.
